set_attributes_span: set OpenInference-compliant LLM attributes on a span for Arize and Phoenix tracing
set_messages_span: set input message attributes on an OpenTelemetry span from chat completion kwargs
set_response_output_messages_span: set output message attributes on an OpenTelemetry span from LLM response choices
infer_open_inference_span_kind: infer the OpenInference span kind from a LiteLLM call type string
set_tool_attributes_span: set tool attributes on an OpenTelemetry span from optional params or metadata tools
